stories.form_behavior: No password entry: post() supplies the default password, and the entity validates and hashes it.

retained_controller_method.reason: Explicitly requested lookup to display the current profile before updating.

runtime_support.auxiliary_controllers: Dashboard, project-interest, shortlist-removal and stored-report controllers support the supplied wireframes and working navigation. Profile/account lists and dropdowns reuse diagram search methods.

validation.boundary: Existing diagram events strip ordinary text and reject missing/malformed fields before controller calls.
validation.controller: Relay only; no field checks, SQL, or copied entity error state.
validation.entity: Validate duplicates, references and saved state; essential defensive checks protect direct/CLI calls.
validation.shared_helpers: infrastructure/validation.py contains the single implementation of pure value rules; boundary/validation.py exposes them to HTTP handlers.

runtime_support.method_explanations: Every application method/function starts with a short explanation; local imports identify their project source files.
runtime_support.entity_method_simplification: Error setters, duplicate-query and New/Past CRUD dispatcher helpers are inlined into diagram operations. Necessary setup, password/session, serialization, ownership, membership, dashboard and report-access helpers remain.
